subject: Money
title: Bitcoin vs Digital Gold
description: A quick, practical guide to Bitcoin vs Digital Gold.

hook.text: Gold has been a store of value for 5,000 years. Bitcoin has existed for 15. Proponents say it's better gold.

buildup.text: Like gold, Bitcoin is scarce, durable, divisible, and portable. Unlike gold, you can send it anywhere in 10 minutes.

discovery.text: Bitcoin's market cap is $1.3 trillion. Gold's is $15 trillion. If Bitcoin took half gold's value, one coin hits $350K.

twist.text: Gold survived thousands of years of wars and collapses. Bitcoin survived 15 years of calm. No true crisis test yet.

climax.text: Bitcoin may become digital gold. Or it may not. That uncertainty is why it trades with extreme volatility.

punchline.text: Gold proved itself in millennia. Bitcoin needs decades.

quiz.question: How does Bitcoin's market cap compare to gold's?
